notablePrerequisites:
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to a creature you control not named Marvin, Murderous Mimic.
description:
Activate Marvin using the creature with Splinter Twin attached's ability by tapping Marvin, causing you to create a token copy of Marvin with haste.
Put the tapped Marvin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.
